## Description

Detect overlapping speech ranges and segments with uncertain attribution; show "Overlapping speech 02:10–02:18 · attribution uncertain" with Assign speaker / Mark unknown. Draft statements derived from those segments stay flagged until resolved.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Segments flagged as overlap/uncertain cannot back an unflagged draft statement.
- [ ] **AC2.** Assign/Mark unknown updates all dependent draft fields' flags.
- [ ] **AC3.** Sign remains blocked while overlap flags are unresolved (counted in "n unresolved").

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
